facts.fact: According to Google's guide, changes to a website can take effect in Google's results within a few hours, while others could take several months.
facts.value: a few hours to several months
facts.quote: Some changes might take effect in a few hours, others could take several months.

facts.fact: Google's guide recommends waiting a few weeks after making changes before assessing whether the work had beneficial effects in Google Search results.
facts.quote: In general, you likely want to wait a few weeks to assess whether your work had beneficial effects in Google Search results.

facts.fact: According to Google's guide, the location of Google's crawler, which determines what information Google sees on location-dependent pages, is generally the US.
facts.quote: crawler's location, which is generally the US.
